verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents Apache Iceberg tables that keep data in external cloud storage you manage, and positions them for existing data lakes you cannot or choose not to store in Snowflake. That covers the Iceberg part of querying open formats in object storage without loading. Delta and raw Parquet files are not evidenced, so only part of the story is delivered. missing for 10: evidence of querying Delta Lake tables, evidence of querying Parquet files directly in object storage (e.g. external tables), independent or hands-on corroboration.
